entries.title: Your language header
entries.desc: The first line of every Soga sketch chooses your language. Arduino IDE needs the Soga library (Tools → Manage Libraries → Soga). After that line, every Arduino word can be written in your language. Other libraries (Servo.h, Wire.h, ...) are included before your language line. The #include lines themselves stay in C++.

entries.title: setup
entries.desc: setup() runs once, when the board is switched on or reset. Use it to set pin modes, start Serial and libraries.

entries.title: loop
entries.desc: loop() runs again and again for as long as the board has power, straight after setup(). Your program lives here.

entries.title: Your own functions
entries.desc: Group steps under a name of your own and call it from setup() or loop(). A function that gives back nothing is void; otherwise return sends a value back.

entries.title: int
entries.desc: A whole number. On Uno, Nano and Mega an int holds -32 768 to 32 767; on ESP32 and Pico it is much larger.

entries.title: unsigned
entries.desc: unsigned in front of a type means "no negative numbers", which doubles the largest positive value. unsigned int: 0 to 65 535 on AVR boards.

entries.title: long
entries.desc: A larger whole number: -2 147 483 648 to 2 147 483 647. Use unsigned long for times from millis() and micros().

syntax.cpp:
long x = 100000;
unsigned long t = millis();
syntax.zu:
ende x = 100000;
ongenaphawu ende t = amamilisekhondi();
syntax.xh:
ende x = 100000;
engenaphawu ende t = iimilisekondi();
syntax.ss:
lokudze x = 100000;
lokungenasibonakaliso lokudze t = emamilisekhondi();
syntax.nr:
okude x = 100000;
okungenatshwayo okude t = amamilisekhondi();
syntax.st:
telele x = 100000;
e_se_nang_tshwayo telele t = dimilisekonde();
syntax.tn:
leele x = 100000;
e_se_na_tshwao leele t = dimilisekonte();
syntax.nso:
telele x = 100000;
ntle_le_leswao telele t = dimilisekhontse();
syntax.ts:
leha x = 100000;
handle_ka_mfungho leha t = timilisekoni();
syntax.ve:
lapfu x = 100000;
hu_si_na_tshiga lapfu t = milisekhondo();
syntax.af:
lank x = 100000;
ongeteken lank t = millisekondes();

entries.title: short
entries.desc: A 16-bit whole number on every board (-32 768 to 32 767).

entries.title: byte, uint8_t
entries.desc: A number from 0 to 255 in one byte of memory. Good for pins, colours and data sent over wires. uint8_t is the same thing.

entries.title: Exact-size numbers
entries.desc: Whole numbers with an exact number of bits, the same on every board: int8_t, int16_t, int32_t and the unsigned uint8_t, uint16_t, uint32_t. Sensors such as the MPU-6050 send int16_t values.

entries.title: size_t
entries.desc: The type for sizes and counts of things in memory. sizeof gives a size_t.

entries.title: float
entries.desc: A number with a decimal point, such as 23.5 degrees. Arduino prints 2 decimal places unless you ask for more.

entries.title: double
entries.desc: A decimal number with more precision. On Uno, Nano and Mega it is the same as float; on ESP32 and Pico it is more precise.

entries.title: bool, true, false
entries.desc: A value that is only true or false. Perfect for "is the light on?" or "was the button pressed?".

entries.title: char
entries.desc: One character, written in single quotes: 'A', '7', '#'. Keypads give a char for each key.

entries.title: String
entries.desc: Text that can grow and change. You can join Strings with +, compare them with == and use the String functions below.

entries.title: Arrays
entries.desc: A row of values of the same type, numbered from 0. pins[0] is the first one. Arrays and a for loop are the easy way to handle many LEDs.

entries.title: auto
entries.desc: Lets the compiler choose the type from the value you give.

entries.title: const
entries.desc: A value that never changes. Use it for pin numbers and fixed times: the compiler stops you from changing it by mistake and uses no extra memory.

entries.title: constexpr
entries.desc: A value worked out while compiling, so it can size arrays.

entries.title: static
entries.desc: Inside a function, a static variable keeps its value between calls instead of starting again each time.

entries.title: volatile
entries.desc: Use volatile for variables that an interrupt changes, so loop() always reads the newest value.

entries.title: HIGH and LOW
entries.desc: HIGH means on (5 V on Uno/Mega, 3.3 V on ESP32/Pico); LOW means off (0 V). digitalRead() also answers HIGH or LOW.

entries.title: INPUT, OUTPUT, INPUT_PULLUP
entries.desc: The three pin modes. OUTPUT drives LEDs, buzzers and relays. INPUT reads a sensor. INPUT_PULLUP reads a button wired to GND: it reads HIGH when not pressed and LOW when pressed, with no resistor needed.

entries.title: LED_BUILTIN
entries.desc: The pin of the small LED on the board itself (pin 13 on Uno and Mega). Handy for testing without any wiring.

entries.title: HEX, DEC, BIN
entries.desc: Choose how print() and println() show a number: DEC (normal, base 10), HEX (base 16, used for RFID cards and IR remotes) or BIN (ones and zeros).

entries.title: nullptr
entries.desc: A pointer that points to nothing yet.

entries.title: if and else
entries.desc: Do something only when a condition is true; else says what to do otherwise. Chain else if for more choices.

entries.title: switch, case, default
entries.desc: Pick one of many paths by the value of a number or char. Each case ends with break; default runs when no case matches.

entries.title: for
entries.desc: Repeat a block a set number of times. The three parts are: start, keep going while, and step.

entries.title: while
entries.desc: Repeat a block for as long as a condition stays true.

entries.title: do ... while
entries.desc: Like while, but the block always runs at least once, because the test comes at the end.

entries.title: break
entries.desc: Leave a for, while or switch straight away.

entries.title: continue
entries.desc: Skip the rest of this round of a loop and go on with the next round.

entries.title: return
entries.desc: End a function, and give back a value if the function has a type.

entries.title: goto
entries.desc: Jump to a named label in the same function. Rarely needed; break and return are usually clearer.

entries.title: and, or, not
entries.desc: Combine conditions. You can write the words, or the symbols && (and), || (or) and ! (not). Both forms mean exactly the same.

entries.title: sizeof
entries.desc: The number of bytes something uses in memory. Divide by the size of one item to count the items of an array.

entries.title: pinMode
entries.desc: Tell a pin whether it gives out power (OUTPUT) or reads (INPUT, INPUT_PULLUP). Do this in setup() for every pin you use.

entries.title: digitalWrite
entries.desc: Switch an OUTPUT pin on (HIGH) or off (LOW): LEDs, active buzzers, relays.

entries.title: digitalRead
entries.desc: Read whether a pin is HIGH or LOW: buttons, PIR motion sensors, tilt switches.

entries.title: analogRead
entries.desc: Measure a voltage: potentiometers, photoresistors (LDR), the water level sensor, the joystick.
params: pin: A0, A1, ... (A0 to A15 on the Mega)
entries.returns: 0 to 1023 on Uno/Mega (0 to 4095 on ESP32)

entries.title: analogWrite
entries.desc: Give a pin "part" power with PWM: dim an LED, mix RGB colours, set a DC motor speed through the L293D.
params: pin: a PWM pin (marked ~ ; 2-13 and 44-46 on the Mega)

entries.title: tone and noTone
entries.desc: Play a note on a passive buzzer; noTone() stops it.

entries.title: pulseIn
entries.desc: Time how long a pin stays HIGH or LOW. The HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor answers with a pulse whose length is the distance.
entries.returns: the length of the pulse in microseconds (0 if none)

syntax.cpp: unsigned long t = pulseIn(pin, HIGH, timeout);
syntax.zu: ongenaphawu ende t = linganisa_ipulse(pin, PHEZULU, timeout);
syntax.xh: engenaphawu ende t = linganisa_ipalsi(pin, PHEZULU, timeout);
syntax.ss: lokungenasibonakaliso lokudze t = linganisa_liphalsi(pin, PHETULU, timeout);
syntax.nr: okungenatshwayo okude t = linganisa_iphalsi(pin, PHEZULU, timeout);
syntax.st: e_se_nang_tshwayo telele t = lekanya_phalese(pin, HODIMO, timeout);
syntax.tn: e_se_na_tshwao leele t = lekanya_phalese(pin, GODIMO, timeout);
syntax.nso: ntle_le_leswao telele t = lekanya_phalese(pin, GODIMO, timeout);
syntax.ts: handle_ka_mfungho leha t = pima_phalisi(pin, HENHLA, timeout);
syntax.ve: hu_si_na_tshiga lapfu t = ela_phalisi(pin, NTHA, timeout);
syntax.af: ongeteken lank t = meet_puls(pin, HOOG, timeout);

entries.title: shiftOut, LSBFIRST, MSBFIRST
entries.desc: Send 8 bits one by one, for example to a 74HC595 shift register that drives 8 LEDs or a 7-segment display from 3 pins.
params: dataPin, clockPin: the pins to the 74HC595

entries.title: shiftIn
entries.desc: Read 8 bits one by one from a shift register such as the 74HC165.

entries.title: delay
entries.desc: Pause the program. Nothing else happens while it waits; for doing two things at once, use millis().

entries.title: delayMicroseconds
entries.desc: Pause for a very short time, in microseconds (1 000 000 = 1 second). Used for sensor trigger pulses.

entries.title: millis
entries.desc: A clock that counts milliseconds. Compare two readings to do something every so often without stopping the program.

entries.title: micros
entries.desc: Like millis(), but in microseconds. Useful for timing very fast events.

entries.title: min, max, abs
entries.desc: The smaller of two values, the larger of two values, and the size of a number without its minus sign.

entries.title: constrain
entries.desc: Keep a value between a lowest and a highest value.

entries.title: map
entries.desc: Re-scale a number from one range to another, for example a 0-1023 reading to a 0-180 servo angle.

entries.title: pow and sqrt
entries.desc: Powers (2 to the 8th = 256) and square roots.

entries.title: sin, cos, tan
entries.desc: Trigonometry with angles in radians (180 degrees = PI radians). Handy for smooth, wave-like movement.

entries.title: floor, ceil, round
entries.desc: Round a decimal number down (floor), up (ceil) or to the nearest whole number (round).

entries.title: isnan
entries.desc: True when a float is "not a number", which is how the DHT11 tells you a reading failed.

entries.title: random and randomSeed
entries.desc: random() gives a surprise number below max. randomSeed() with a reading from an unconnected analog pin makes the numbers different every time the board starts.

entries.title: bitRead, bitWrite, bitSet, bitClear
entries.desc: Read or change one bit (one of the 8 switches) inside a byte. Bit 0 is the rightmost.

syntax.cpp: bitRead(x, n)  bitWrite(x, n, value)  bitSet(x, n)  bitClear(x, n)
syntax.zu: funda_ibhithi(x, n)  bhala_ibhithi(x, n, value)  setha_ibhithi(x, n)  sula_ibhithi(x, n)
syntax.xh: funda_ibhithi(x, n)  bhala_ibhithi(x, n, value)  misela_ibhithi(x, n)  cima_ibhithi(x, n)
syntax.ss: fundza_libhithi(x, n)  bhala_libhithi(x, n, value)  setha_libhithi(x, n)  sula_libhithi(x, n)
syntax.nr: funda_ibhithi(x, n)  tlola_ibhithi(x, n, value)  setha_ibhithi(x, n)  sula_ibhithi(x, n)

syntax.af: lees_bis(x, n)  skryf_bis(x, n, value)  stel_bis(x, n)  wis_bis(x, n)

entries.title: highByte and lowByte
entries.desc: Split a 16-bit number into its two bytes, for sending over Wire or saving in EEPROM.

entries.title: attachInterrupt
entries.desc: Run a function the instant a pin changes, even in the middle of loop(). Used for rotary encoders and fast buttons.
params: pin: 2, 3, 18, 19, 20 or 21 on the Mega (2 and 3 on the Uno)
function: your function with no inputs
mode: RISING (LOW to HIGH), FALLING (HIGH to LOW) or CHANGE (either)

entries.title: detachInterrupt
entries.desc: Stop an interrupt you attached.

entries.title: interrupts and noInterrupts
entries.desc: Pause all interrupts for a moment while you copy a value they change, then switch them back on.

entries.title: Serial and begin
entries.desc: Serial talks to the computer over the USB cable. begin() starts it at a speed (9600 is usual). Open Tools → Serial Monitor and pick the same speed to see the messages.

entries.title: print and println
entries.desc: Send text or numbers to the Serial Monitor. println() adds a new line at the end; print() does not. The LCD uses the same words.

entries.title: available and read
entries.desc: available() tells you how many characters have arrived from the computer; read() takes the next one.

entries.title: write
entries.desc: Send raw bytes instead of text. The same word is used to send bytes over Wire (I2C), to move a servo and to save to EEPROM.

entries.title: parseInt and parseFloat
entries.desc: Read a whole typed number (or a decimal number) from the Serial Monitor.

entries.title: readString and readStringUntil
entries.desc: Read typed text as a String: everything that arrived, or up to a character you choose.

entries.title: length
entries.desc: How many characters a String has.

entries.title: toInt and toFloat
entries.desc: Turn text that holds a number into a real number you can calculate with.

entries.title: indexOf and substring
entries.desc: indexOf() finds where something is in a String (or -1 if it is not there); substring() cuts out a part.

entries.title: trim
entries.desc: Remove spaces and new-line characters from both ends of a String.

entries.title: toUpperCase and toLowerCase
entries.desc: Change a String to capital letters or to small letters, so "On", "ON" and "on" all match.

entries.title: startsWith and endsWith
entries.desc: Check how a String begins or ends.

entries.title: replace
entries.desc: Replace every copy of one piece of text with another.

entries.title: isdigit, isalpha, toupper
entries.desc: Test or change a single char: is it a digit? a letter? a space? Make it a capital or a small letter.

entries.title: struct
entries.desc: Bundle several values into one new type, for example the three pins of one traffic light.

syntax.zu: isakhiwo Name { inombolo a; inombolo b; };

entries.title: enum
entries.desc: A list of named choices. Good for the states of a machine, such as the colours of a traffic light.

entries.title: class, public, private
entries.desc: A class bundles values and the functions that use them. public parts can be used from outside; private parts are hidden.

syntax.cpp: class Name { public: void f(); private: int x; };

entries.title: Servo, attach, write
entries.desc: Control the SG90 servo: attach() connects it to a pin (orange wire), write() turns it to an angle from 0 to 180 degrees.

entries.title: writeMicroseconds and detach
entries.desc: writeMicroseconds() sets the servo pulse exactly (1000 to 2000; 1500 is the middle). detach() lets the servo go limp and saves power.

entries.title: Wire, beginTransmission, endTransmission
entries.desc: I2C connects many modules (MPU-6050, DS3231, LCD backpacks) on two wires: SDA (pin 20 on the Mega) and SCL (pin 21). Start a message to a module address, write bytes, and end it.

entries.title: requestFrom
entries.desc: Ask a module for a number of bytes, then read them with available() and read().

entries.title: onReceive and onRequest
entries.desc: Make the board itself an I2C module: run a function when another board sends to it, or asks it for data.

entries.title: SPI and transfer
entries.desc: SPI is a fast 4-wire bus used by the RC522 RFID reader and SD cards (pins 50-53 on the Mega). transfer() sends a byte and receives one at the same time.

entries.title: EEPROM, read, write, update, put
entries.desc: Memory that remembers even when the power is off (4096 bytes on the Mega). update() only writes when the value changed, which makes the memory last longer.

entries.title: Stepper, setSpeed, step
entries.desc: The 28BYJ-48 stepper with the ULN2003 board: 2048 steps make one turn. setSpeed() sets turns per minute; step() moves (negative numbers go backwards).

entries.title: LiquidCrystal, setCursor, clear
entries.desc: Write on the 16x2 LCD. begin() sets its size, setCursor() moves to a column (0-15) and row (0-1), print() writes, clear() wipes it.

entries.title: home, cursor, blink
entries.desc: home() goes back to the top-left; cursor()/noCursor() show or hide the underline cursor; blink()/noBlink() make a blinking block.

entries.title: display, scroll, autoscroll
entries.desc: Switch the text off and on without losing it, slide everything left or right, or make new letters push the text along.

entries.title: createChar
entries.desc: Draw your own character (5x8 dots), such as a heart, and print it with write().

entries.title: readTemperature and readHumidity
entries.desc: Read degrees Celsius and relative humidity (%) from the DHT11. Read at most once every 2 seconds. Needs the "DHT sensor library" from Adafruit.

entries.title: PCD_Init, PICC_IsNewCardPresent, PICC_ReadCardSerial
entries.desc: Read the number of the white card or blue key fob. Wire SDA to 53, SCK 52, MOSI 51, MISO 50, RST 5 and power at 3.3 V. Needs the "MFRC522" library.

entries.title: DateTime, now, adjust, lostPower
entries.desc: The DS3231 keeps the date and time even with the power off. now() reads it; adjust() sets it; lostPower() is true when the coin battery ran out. Needs the "RTClib" library.

entries.title: year, month, day, hour, minute, second
entries.desc: Take a DateTime apart. dayOfTheWeek() is 0 for Sunday up to 6 for Saturday.

entries.title: IrReceiver, decode, resume
entries.desc: Read the buttons of the small remote. decode() is true when a button was pressed; decodedIRData.command is its number; resume() gets ready for the next one. Needs the "IRremote" library.

entries.title: Keypad, makeKeymap, getKey, NO_KEY

entries.title: setDigit and setChar
entries.desc: For MAX7219 boards with 7-segment digits: show a number or a letter at a position.

entries.title: SevSeg, setNumber, refreshDisplay
entries.desc: Show numbers on the 4-digit display. Call refreshDisplay() every time loop() runs, without long delays. Needs the "SevSeg" library.

ui.cover_lede: Incwadi yokufunda wonke amagama nemisebenzi ye-Arduino, ngalinye linesibonelo esisebenzayo, ngesiZulu, isiXhosa, isiSwati, isiNdebele, iSesotho, iSetswana, iSepedi, isiTsonga, isiVenda nesiBhunu.
ui.fact1: Kusuka ku-qala no-phindaphinda kuya kumaservo, ama-LCD, i-RFID newashi.
ui.fact2: Isibonelo ngasinye sakhiwe nge-Arduino Mega 2560 ngazo zonke izilimi eziyishumi.
ui.fact3: Faka umtapo we-Soga ku-Arduino IDE, bese uqala uhlelo lwakho ngesihloko solimi lwakho.
ui.needs_library: Lesi sibonelo sidinga isihloko somtapo {h}, esifakwa ngaphambi komugqa wolimi lwakho.
ui.serial_note: Kuqoshwe ngokusebenzisa lesi sibonelo ku-Arduino Mega 2560 elingisiwe (simavr), ngo-9600 baud.
ui.copy_note: Kopisha isibonelo ku-Arduino IDE bese usilayisha ku-Arduino Mega 2560. Ithebhu ethi C++ ikhombisa lolu hlelo olufanayo ngekhodi ye-Arduino ejwayelekile; zombili zakha uhlelo olufanayo ncamashi.
ui.start1: Ku-Arduino IDE vula Tools → Manage Libraries…, sesha Soga bese uchofoza Install.
ui.start2: Yenza u-{h} ube umugqa wokuqala wohlelo lwakho.
ui.words_desc: Wonke amagama e-Arduino awaziwa i-Soga. Chofoza igama elinesifundo ukuze usivule. Amagama angekho ohlwini (A0, PI, DHT11, amagama ama-chip) abhalwa ngendlela efanayo kuzo zonke izilimi.
ui.foot1: Incwadi ye-Arduino ye-Soga · ibhalwe nguMzwandile Zulu · Creative Minds Technologies
ui.foot2: Ukuze uthole usizo: shayela u-067 489 5678 noma uthumele i-imeyili ku-creativemindstechnologies56@gmail.com
ui.foot3: Amagama nezincazelo ziwuhlaka lokuqala olusabuyekezwa ngabakhuluma isiZulu.
ui.missing: Lesi sifundo asikho. Iya esifundweni sokuqala.

header.title: Isihloko solimi lwakho
header.desc: Umugqa wokuqala walo lonke uhlelo lwe-Soga ukhetha ulimi lwakho. I-Arduino IDE idinga umtapo we-Soga (Tools → Manage Libraries → Soga). Ngemuva kwalowo mugqa, wonke amagama e-Arduino angabhalwa ngolimi lwakho. Eminye imitapo (Servo.h, Wire.h, ...) ifakwa ngaphambi komugqa wolimi lwakho. Imigqa ka-#include uqobo lwayo ihlala ingeye-C++.

setup.desc: qala() isebenza kanye kuphela, lapho ibhodi livulwa noma lisethwa kabusha (reset). Yisebenzise ukusetha amaphini, ukuqala i-Serial nemitapo.

loop.desc: phindaphinda() isebenza njalo njalo uma nje ibhodi linogesi, ngokushesha ngemuva kuka-qala(). Uhlelo lwakho luhlala lapha.

functions.title: Imisebenzi yakho
functions.desc: Hlanganisa izinyathelo ngaphansi kwegama lakho bese uzibiza ku-qala() noma ku-phindaphinda(). Umsebenzi ongabuyisi lutho ngu-ize; uma kungenjalo, buyisa uthumela inani emuva.

int.desc: Inombolo ephelele. Ku-Uno, Nano naku-Mega, inombolo ithwala kusuka ku -32 768 kuya ku-32 767; ku-ESP32 naku-Pico inkulu kakhulu.

unsigned.desc: ongenaphawu phambi kohlobo kusho ukuthi "azikho izinombolo ezingaphansi kuka-0", okuphinda kabili inani elikhulu kunawo wonke. ongenaphawu inombolo: kusuka ku-0 kuya ku-65 535 kumabhodi e-AVR.

long.desc: Inombolo ephelele enkulu: kusuka ku -2 147 483 648 kuya ku-2 147 483 647. Sebenzisa ongenaphawu ende ezikhathini ezivela ku-amamilisekhondi() naku-amamayikhrosekhondi().

short.desc: Inombolo ephelele yamabhithi ayi-16 kuwo wonke amabhodi (-32 768 kuya ku-32 767).

byte.desc: Inombolo esuka ku-0 kuya ku-255 ebhayithini elilodwa lenkumbulo. Ilungele amaphini, imibala nedatha ethunyelwa ngezintambo. ongenaphawu8 kuyinto efanayo.

fixedint.title: Izinombolo zosayizi oqondile
fixedint.desc: Izinombolo eziphelele ezinenani eliqondile lamabhithi, ezifanayo kuwo wonke amabhodi: inombolo8, inombolo16, inombolo32 nezingenaphawu ongenaphawu8, ongenaphawu16, ongenaphawu32. Izinzwa ezifana ne-MPU-6050 zithumela amanani e-inombolo16.

size_t.desc: Uhlobo losayizi nenani lezinto enkumbulweni. usayizi unikeza inombolo_kasayizi.

float.desc: Inombolo enechashazi ledesimali, njengama-degree angu-23.5. I-Arduino ibonisa izindawo ezi-2 zedesimali ngaphandle kokuthi ucele ezengeziwe.

double.desc: Inombolo yedesimali enembe kakhulu. Ku-Uno, Nano naku-Mega iyafana ne-idesimali; ku-ESP32 naku-Pico inemba kakhulu.

bool.desc: Inani elingaba yi-iqiniso noma amanga kuphela. Lilungele imibuzo efana nethi "ingabe ilambu likhanyile?" noma "ingabe inkinobho icindezelwe?".

char.desc: Uhlamvu olulodwa, olubhalwa phakathi kwezimpawu zokucaphuna ezilodwa: 'A', '7', '#'. Amakhiphedi anikeza uhlamvu lwenkinobho ngayinye.

String.desc: Umbhalo ongakhula futhi ushintshe. Ungahlanganisa imibhalo ngo-+, uyiqhathanise ngo-== futhi usebenzise imisebenzi yombhalo engezansi.

arrays.title: Ama-array (uhide lwamanani)
arrays.desc: Uhide lwamanani ohlobo olufanayo, alinganiswa kusuka ku-0. pins[0] yilona lokuqala. Ama-array kanye no-jikeleza yindlela elula yokuphatha ama-LED amaningi.

auto.desc: Ivumela i-compiler ukuthi izikhethele uhlobo ngokwenani olinikezayo.

const.desc: Inani elingaguquki. Lisebenzisele izinombolo zamaphini nezikhathi ezingaguquki: i-compiler iyakuvimba ukuthi ulishintshe ngephutha futhi alisebenzisi nkumbulo eyengeziwe.

constexpr.desc: Inani elibalwa lapho uhlelo lwakhiwa (compile), ngakho lingasetha usayizi wama-array.

static.desc: Ngaphakathi komsebenzi, isiguquguquki esingu-okumile sigcina inani laso phakathi kwezingcingo esikhundleni sokuqala phansi njalo.

volatile.desc: Sebenzisa okuguquguqukayo eziguquguqukini ezishintshwa ukuphazamiseka (interrupt), ukuze phindaphinda() ihlale ifunda inani elisha kakhulu.

HIGH.desc: PHEZULU kusho ukuthi kuvuliwe (5 V ku-Uno/Mega, 3.3 V ku-ESP32/Pico); PHANSI kusho ukuthi kucishiwe (0 V). funda_idijithali() nayo iphendula ngo-PHEZULU noma PHANSI.

INPUT.desc: Izindlela ezintathu zamaphini. OKUPHUMAYO kushayela ama-LED, amabhaza nama-relay. OKUNGENAYO kufunda inzwa. OKUNGENAYO_KUDONSELWE kufunda inkinobho exhunywe ku-GND: kufunda PHEZULU uma ingacindezelwe, futhi PHANSI uma icindezelwe, ngaphandle kwe-resistor.

LED_BUILTIN.desc: Iphini le-LED encane esebhodini uqobo (iphini 13 ku-Uno naku-Mega). Ilungele ukuhlola ngaphandle kokuxhuma lutho.

HEX.desc: Khetha ukuthi bonisa() no-bonisa_umugqa() zibonisa kanjani inombolo: NGEDESIMALI (okujwayelekile, isisekelo esingu-10), NGEHEKSA (isisekelo esingu-16, esisetshenziswa amakhadi e-RFID namarimothi e-IR) noma NGEBHINARI (ama-1 nama-0).

if.desc: Yenza okuthile kuphela uma isimo siyiqiniso; kungenjalo kusho okumele kwenziwe uma singesona. Hlanganisa kungenjalo uma ukuze uthole ukukhetha okuningi.

switch.desc: Khetha indlela eyodwa kwezintathu noma ngaphezulu ngokwenani lenombolo noma lohlamvu. isimo ngasinye siphela ngo-phuma; okujwayelekile kusebenza uma singekho isimo esifanayo.

for.desc: Phinda ibhulokhi inani elithile lezikhathi. Izingxenye ezintathu zithi: qala lapha, qhubeka uma, bese wenyusa kanje.

while.desc: Phinda ibhulokhi uma nje isimo sisaliqiniso.

do.title: yenza ... ngenkathi
do.desc: Kufana no-ngenkathi, kodwa ibhulokhi ihlale isebenza okungenani kanye, ngoba ukuhlola kwenzeka ekugcineni.

break.desc: Phuma ku-jikeleza, ngenkathi noma ku-khetha ngokushesha.

continue.desc: Yeqa okusele kwalo mjikelezo bese uqhubeka nomjikelezo olandelayo.

return.desc: Qeda umsebenzi, futhi ubuyise inani uma umsebenzi unohlobo.

goto.desc: Gxumela kulebula eqanjwe ngegama emsebenzini ofanayo. Akuvamile ukuthi kudingeke; phuma no-buyisa kuvame ukucaca kakhulu.

logic.desc: Hlanganisa izimo. Ungabhala amagama, noma izimpawu && (futhi), || (noma) no-! (hhayi). Zombili lezi zindlela zisho into efanayo ncamashi.

sizeof.desc: Inani lamabhayithi into ewasebenzisayo enkumbulweni. Hlukanisa ngosayizi wento eyodwa ukuze ubale izinto ezise-array.

pinMode.desc: Tshela iphini ukuthi linikeza ugesi (OKUPHUMAYO) noma liyafunda (OKUNGENAYO, OKUNGENAYO_KUDONSELWE). Kwenze lokhu ku-qala() kulo lonke iphini olisebenzisayo.

digitalWrite.desc: Vula (PHEZULU) noma vala (PHANSI) iphini elingu-OKUPHUMAYO: ama-LED, amabhaza asebenzayo, ama-relay.

digitalRead.desc: Funda ukuthi iphini lingu-PHEZULU noma PHANSI: izinkinobho, izinzwa zokunyakaza ze-PIR, ama-switch okutshekisa.

analogRead.desc: Linganisa amandla kagesi (voltage): ama-potentiometer, ama-photoresistor (LDR), inzwa yamanzi, i-joystick.
params: iphini: A0, A1, ... (A0 kuya ku-A15 ku-Mega)
analogRead.returns: 0 kuya ku-1023 ku-Uno/Mega (0 kuya ku-4095 ku-ESP32)

analogWrite.desc: Nikeza iphini "ingxenye" kagesi nge-PWM: fiphaza i-LED, xuba imibala ye-RGB, setha ijubane lemotha ye-DC nge-L293D.

tone.desc: Dlala inothi ebhazeni elingasebenzi ngokwalo (passive); misa_ithoni() iyalimisa.

pulseIn.desc: Linganisa isikhathi iphini elihlala ngaso lingu-PHEZULU noma PHANSI. Inzwa ye-HC-SR04 ye-ultrasonic iphendula ngepulse ubude bayo obungu-ibanga.

shiftOut.desc: Thumela amabhithi angu-8 ngalinye ngalinye, isibonelo ku-74HC595 eshayela ama-LED angu-8 noma isibonisi se-7-segment ngamaphini ama-3 kuphela.
params: iphini ledatha, iphini lewashi: amaphini aya ku-74HC595

shiftIn.desc: Funda amabhithi angu-8 ngalinye ngalinye ku-shift register efana ne-74HC165.

delay.desc: Misa uhlelo okwesikhashana. Akukho okunye okwenzekayo ngesikhathi silinda; ukuze wenze izinto ezimbili ngesikhathi esisodwa, sebenzisa amamilisekhondi().

delayMicroseconds.desc: Misa isikhashana esifushane kakhulu, ngama-microsecond (1 000 000 = umzuzwana owodwa). Kusetshenziselwa amapulse okuvusa izinzwa.

millis.desc: Iwashi elibala ama-millisecond. Qhathanisa ukufunda okubili ukuze wenze okuthile njalo ngemuva kwesikhathi esithile ngaphandle kokumisa uhlelo.

micros.desc: Kufana no-amamilisekhondi(), kodwa ngama-microsecond. Kuyasiza ukulinganisa izehlakalo ezishesha kakhulu.

minmax.desc: Elincane kwamabili, elikhulu kwamabili, nobukhulu benombolo ngaphandle kophawu lokususa.

constrain.desc: Gcina inani phakathi kwenani eliphansi kakhulu nelikhulu kakhulu.

map.desc: Linganisa kabusha inombolo isuka kobunye ububanzi iya kobunye, isibonelo ukufunda okungu-0-1023 kube i-engeli ye-servo engu-0-180.

trig.desc: I-trigonometry ngama-engeli ngama-radian (180 degrees = PI radians). Iyasiza ekunyakazeni okubushelelezi okufana namagagasi.

round.desc: Sondeza inombolo yedesimali phansi (ehlisa), phezulu (nyusa) noma enombolweni ephelele eseduze (sondeza). Ku-Uno naku-Mega, sondeza() inikeza inombolo ephelele.

isnan.desc: Iqiniso uma idesimali "ingeyona inombolo", okuyindlela i-DHT11 ekutshela ngayo ukuthi ukufunda kuhlulekile.

random.desc: khetha_ngokungahleliwe() inikeza inombolo engalindelekile engaphansi kokukhulu. imbewu_yokungahleliwe() nokufunda kwephini le-analogi elingaxhunyiwe kwenza izinombolo zehluke njalo uma ibhodi liqala.

bitRead.desc: Funda noma ushintshe ibhithi elilodwa (elilodwa kuma-switch angu-8) ngaphakathi kwebhayithi. Ibhithi 0 yilona elingakwesokudla kakhulu.

highByte.desc: Hlukanisa inombolo yamabhithi ayi-16 ibe amabhayithi ayo amabili, ukuze uyithumele ngo-Ucingo noma uyigcine ku-EEPROM.

attachInterrupt.desc: Sebenzisa umsebenzi ngokushesha lapho iphini lishintsha, ngisho naphakathi kuka-phindaphinda(). Kusetshenziselwa ama-rotary encoder nezinkinobho ezisheshayo.
params: indlela: KUYENYUKA (PHANSI kuya ku-PHEZULU), KUYEHLA (PHEZULU kuya ku-PHANSI) noma UMA_KUSHINTSHA (noma yikuphi)

interrupts.desc: Misa konke ukuphazamiseka okwesikhashana ngenkathi ukopisha inani abalishintshayo, bese ubuye ukuvule.

Serial.desc: Isiriyeli ikhuluma nekhompyutha ngentambo ye-USB. ukuqala() iyiqalisa ngejubane (9600 lijwayelekile). Vula Tools → Serial Monitor bese ukhetha ijubane elifanayo ukuze ubone imilayezo.

print.desc: Thumela umbhalo noma izinombolo ku-Serial Monitor. bonisa_umugqa() yengeza umugqa omusha ekugcineni; bonisa() ayengezi. I-LCD isebenzisa amagama afanayo.

available.desc: kutholakalayo() ikutshela ukuthi zingaki izinhlamvu ezifikile zivela ekhompyutheni; funda_ibhayithi() ithatha olulandelayo.

write.desc: Thumela amabhayithi angempela esikhundleni sombhalo. Igama elifanayo lisetshenziselwa ukuthumela amabhayithi ngo-Ucingo (I2C), ukunyakazisa i-servo nokugcina ku-EEPROM.

parseInt.desc: Funda inombolo ephelele ethayiphiwe (noma inombolo yedesimali) ku-Serial Monitor.

readString.desc: Funda umbhalo othayiphiwe njengo-umbhalo: konke okufikile, noma kuze kube uhlamvu olukhethayo.

toInt.desc: Guqula umbhalo onenombolo ube inombolo yangempela ongabala ngayo.

indexOf.desc: indawo_ka() ithola ukuthi into ithile ikuphi embhalweni (noma -1 uma ingekho); ingxenye_yombhalo() isika ingxenye.

trim.desc: Susa izikhala nezinhlamvu zomugqa omusha kuzo zombili izinhlangothi zombhalo.

case.desc: Shintsha umbhalo ube ngamagama amakhulu noma amancane, ukuze u-"On", u-"ON" no-"on" konke kufane.

startsWith.desc: Hlola ukuthi umbhalo uqala noma uphela kanjani.

replace.desc: Faka omunye umbhalo esikhundleni sazo zonke izikhathi umbhalo othile ovela ngazo.

chars.desc: Hlola noma ushintshe uhlamvu olulodwa: ingabe yidijithi? uhlamvu lwe-alfabhethi? isikhala? Lwenze lube olukhulu noma oluncane.

struct.desc: Hlanganisa amanani amaningana abe uhlobo olusha olulodwa, isibonelo amaphini amathathu amalambu omgwaqo.

enum.desc: Uhlu lokukhetha okunamagama. Kuhle ezimweni zomshini, njengemibala yamalambu omgwaqo.

class.desc: Isigaba sihlanganisa amanani nemisebenzi ewasebenzisayo. Izingxenye ezingu-umphakathi zingasetshenziswa ngaphandle; izingxenye ezingu-imfihlo ziyafihlwa.

Servo.desc: Lawula i-servo ye-SG90: xhuma() iyixhuma ephinini (intambo ewolintshi), bhala_ibhayithi() iyijikisela ku-engeli esuka ku-0 kuya ku-180 degrees.

writeMicroseconds.desc: bhala_amamayikhrosekhondi() isetha ipulse ye-servo ngokunembile (1000 kuya ku-2000; 1500 iphakathi). hlukanisa() ivumela i-servo ikhululeke futhi yonga ugesi.

Wire.desc: I-I2C ixhuma amamojula amaningi (MPU-6050, DS3231, ama-backpack e-LCD) ngezintambo ezimbili: SDA (iphini 20 ku-Mega) no-SCL (iphini 21). Qala umlayezo oya ekhelini lemojula, bhala amabhayithi, bese uwuqeda.

requestFrom.desc: Cela imojula inani elithile lamabhayithi, bese uwafunda ngo-kutholakalayo() no-funda_ibhayithi().

onReceive.desc: Yenza ibhodi ngokwalo libe imojula ye-I2C: sebenzisa umsebenzi lapho elinye ibhodi lithumela kulo, noma licela idatha kulo.

SPI.desc: I-SPI yibhasi elisheshayo lezintambo ezi-4 elisetshenziswa isifundi se-RFID RC522 namakhadi e-SD (amaphini 50-53 ku-Mega). dlulisa() ithumela ibhayithi futhi yamukele elinye ngesikhathi esisodwa.

EEPROM.desc: Inkumbulo ekhumbulayo ngisho noma ugesi ucishiwe (amabhayithi angu-4096 ku-Mega). buyekeza() ibhala kuphela uma inani lishintshile, okwenza inkumbulo ihlale isikhathi eside.

Stepper.desc: Imotha yesitebhu ye-28BYJ-48 nebhodi le-ULN2003: izinyathelo ezingu-2048 zenza umjikelezo owodwa. setha_ijubane() isetha imijikelezo ngomzuzu; thatha_izinyathelo() iyanyakaza (izinombolo ezingaphansi kuka-0 ziya emuva).

LiquidCrystal.desc: Bhala esikrinini se-LCD esingu-16x2. ukuqala() isetha usayizi waso, setha_ikhesa() iya kukholomu (0-15) nomugqa (0-1), bonisa() iyabhala, sula_konke() iyasesula.

lcdcursor.desc: buyela_ekuqaleni() ibuyela phezulu kwesobunxele; bonisa_ikhesa()/fihla_ikhesa() ibonisa noma ifihla ikhesa elingumugqa; cwayiza_ikhesa()/misa_ukucwayiza() yenza ibhulokhi elicwayizayo.

lcddisplay.desc: Cisha bese ukhanyisa umbhalo ngaphandle kokuwulahla, shelelisa konke kwesobunxele noma kwesokudla, noma wenze izinhlamvu ezintsha zisunduze umbhalo.

createChar.desc: Dweba uhlamvu lwakho (amachashazi angu-5x8), njengenhliziyo, bese uluphrinta ngo-bhala_ibhayithi().

DHT.desc: Funda ama-degree Celsius nomswakama (%) ku-DHT11. Funda kanye kuphela emizuzwaneni emi-2. Kudingeka umtapo othi "DHT sensor library" ka-Adafruit.

MFRC522.desc: Funda inombolo yekhadi elimhlophe noma ye-key fob eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka. Xhuma i-SDA ku-53, i-SCK ku-52, i-MOSI ku-51, i-MISO ku-50, i-RST ku-5 nogesi ku-3.3 V. Kudingeka umtapo othi "MFRC522".

RTClib.desc: I-DS3231 igcina usuku nesikhathi ngisho noma ugesi ucishiwe. manje() iyakufunda; lungisa_isikhathi() iyakusetha; kulahlekile_amandla() iyiqiniso uma ibhethri elincane liphelile. Kudingeka umtapo othi "RTClib".

DateTimeParts.desc: Hlukanisa u-Usuku_nesikhathi ube izingxenye zalo. usuku_lwesonto() ngu-0 ngeSonto kuya ku-6 ngoMgqibelo.

IrReceiver.desc: Funda izinkinobho zerimothi encane. humusha_isignali() iyiqiniso uma inkinobho icindezelwe; idatha_ehunyushiwe.umyalo yinombolo yayo; qhubeka_ulalele() ilungiselela elandelayo. Kudingeka umtapo othi "IRremote".

Keypad.desc: Funda izinkinobho eziyi-16. thola_inkinobho() inikeza uhlamvu lwenkinobho ecindezelwe, noma AKUKHO_NKINOBHO uma kungacindezelwe lutho. Kudingeka umtapo othi "Keypad".

LedControl.desc: Qalisa imatriki engu-8x8: yivuse ngo-lalisa(0, amanga), setha ukukhanya ku-0-15, bese uyisula. Kudingeka umtapo othi "LedControl".

setLed.desc: Khanyisa ichashazi elilodwa, umugqa wonke (amachashazi angu-8 avela ebhayithini elilodwa) noma ikholomu yonke.

setDigit.desc: Kumabhodi e-MAX7219 anezinombolo ze-7-segment: bonisa inombolo noma uhlamvu endaweni ethile.

SevSeg.desc: Bonisa izinombolo esibonisini sezinombolo ezi-4. Biza vuselela_isibonisi() njalo lapho phindaphinda() isebenza, ngaphandle kokulinda isikhathi eside. Kudingeka umtapo othi "SevSeg".
